option.boat-utils.unrestricted_view_rota: Removes the vanilla 180-degree yaw restriction, allowing the camera to rotate freely in a full circle.
option.boat-utils.view_direction_lock_en: Makes the boat follow the view direction. Left and right movement keys strafe horizontally instead of turning the boat.
option.boat-utils.blue_ice_speed_everywh: Makes the boat use blue ice friction at all times.
option.boat-utils.prevent_sinking.toolti: While the boat is underwater, sets an upward speed to prevent it from sinking.
option.boat-utils.boat_step_height.toolt: Sets the maximum height the boat can step up while moving. Range: 0.0 to 10.0 blocks.
option.boat-utils.handbrake_enabled.tool: While controlling a boat, holding the jump key applies the handbrake.
option.boat-utils.handbrake_boost_enable: If enabled, after releasing the handbrake, adds a boost based on how long the handbrake was held.
